description.text:
A top-four deck of the Junior Division at the 2012 World Championships that made an unlikely star of Celebi Prime, whose Energy-gathering power keeps Mewtwo-EX and Tornadus-EX attacking, with plenty of card drawing and a little healing. The 2012 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa, Hawaii, from 10 to 12 August 2012.

Pokémon sold it as a 2012 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
